svg.title: Adonai: Lord, my Lord
svg.desc: Adonai, אֲדֹנָי: Lord, my Lord. O Lord GOD, what will you give me, for I continue childless … “Look toward heaven, and number the stars, if you are able to number them.” (Genesis 15:2, 5 (ESV)). In the scene: brought outside (Genesis 15:5); the stars he could not number (15:5); his tent (12:8).
